quote.text: A seeker of refuge would seek refuge in the Sacred House and an army would be sent to him, and when it would enter a plain ground, it would be made to sink.

shots.framing: HOOK. Wide, low: night desert; an endless column of armoured trucks with headlights rolls toward camera across a flat plain; in the foreground a young soldier (20s, helmet, simple face) rides on the side of a truck, staring ahead; thin cracks start to run through the sand under the wheels
shots.vo_markup: An army marched into the desert to kill one *man.*
shots.vo: An army marched into the desert to kill one man.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The column of lights, the young soldier
shots.notes: Alive from frame 0 (headlights bouncing, dust). The first crack appears on "man".

shots.framing: Extreme wide: the plain caves in under the column; the headlights tilt and sink into a vast collapsing pit, a wall of dust rising and swallowing the lights. No bodies
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: The collapse starts on "swallowed". Hard cut after.

shots.framing: Medium-wide: the quiet old stone street from Chapter 7; the giver seen ONLY FROM BEHIND (back of head, shoulders square to camera), backlit by the warm doorway, scooping handfuls into the hands of a line of poor people
shots.vo_markup: Weeks earlier, he was just a man in a quiet city, giving away gold without *counting.*
shots.vo: Weeks earlier, he was just a man in a quiet city, giving away gold without counting.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: a busy market; a fruit seller leans to an old customer and whispers; behind them two women whisper too, a man stops and turns; the whisper travels along the stalls
shots.vo_markup: People began to whisper that he was the one the Prophet had *promised.*
shots.vo: People began to whisper that he was the one the Prophet had promised.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The whisper passing from mouth to ear
shots.notes: On "promised" the old customer closes her eyes, moved.

shots.framing: Wide: a grey street behind a barbed-wire barricade; people queue for bread with empty bags under the eye of distant faceless guards; a boy holds his mother's hand and looks up
shots.vo_markup: A man from the Prophet's own family, who would fill the earth with justice... as it had been filled with *oppression.*
shots.vo: A man from the Prophet's own family, who would fill the earth with justice... as it had been filled with oppression.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The bread queue behind the wire
shots.notes: No violence. The boy looks up on "oppression".

shots.framing: Medium: night, the giver (FROM BEHIND only) steps out of a side door with a small cloth bag over his shoulder and walks away down a dark alley toward a distant road
shots.vo: He never claimed it. He ran.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Faceless. He turns the corner on "ran".

shots.framing: Wide: night; a vast sea of pilgrims in white seen from behind, flowing toward a great glow of white light beyond tall minarets (the House itself is NOT shown, only its light); the giver, a tiny figure from behind, merges into the crowd
shots.camera: Slow crane down into the crowd
shots.vo_markup: He fled to the one place no army should ever touch: the Sacred House in *Mecca.*
shots.vo: He fled to the one place no army should ever touch: the Sacred House in Mecca.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The white sea of people, the glow
shots.notes: Respectful, luminous. The glow swells softly on "Mecca".

shots.framing: Medium: a dark room; three faceless men in plain suits around a table lit from below by a desk lamp; an unnamed map with no borders or text; one fist comes down on the map
shots.vo_markup: But the men who feared him sent an army after *him.*
shots.vo: But the men who feared him sent an army after him.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: No flags, no insignia, no text on the map. The fist lands on "him".

shots.framing: Extreme wide: blazing day; the army column snakes across the desert to the horizon, dust trailing; plain vehicles, NO flags or insignia
shots.vo_markup: Soldiers, trucks, armour. A column longer than the *horizon.*
shots.vo: Soldiers, trucks, armour. A column longer than the horizon.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Extreme wide: dusk; the column, tiny, enters a perfectly flat, pale plain ringed by low dark hills; long shadows; dust glowing
shots.vo_markup: Fourteen centuries ago, the Prophet said a man would seek refuge in the House, an army would be sent against him, and when it reached open ground, the earth would *swallow* it.
shots.vo: Fourteen centuries ago, the Prophet said a man would seek refuge in the House, an army would be sent against him, and when it reached open ground, the earth would swallow it.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Tiny column on the open plain
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay on this shot: keep the top ~15–40% dark and calm.

shots.framing: Close: a soldier's hand resting on the hot hood of a truck; grains of sand start to dance on the metal; a canteen beside it rattles; the hand lifts slightly
shots.vo: Then the sand began to tremble.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Extreme wide: the plain splits open in a huge ring around the column; the trucks tilt and slide down into the sinking ground amid towering dust; NO bodies, no people visible
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Wide, low: dawn; perfectly flat sand; a set of tire tracks runs toward the horizon and simply ends; wind lifts a little dust; one helmet half-buried
shots.vo_markup: By morning, there was only flat sand... and tire tracks that led *nowhere.*
shots.vo: By morning, there was only flat sand... and tire tracks that led nowhere.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Camera reaches the end of the tracks on "nowhere".

shots.framing: Wide: dawn; the white-clad crowd seen from behind, thousands of hands reaching toward a tiny figure in the distance (from behind, faceless) standing on a low step in front of the glow
shots.vo_markup: In Mecca, a hundred thousand hands reached toward the man who had *run.*
shots.vo: In Mecca, a hundred thousand hands reached toward the man who had run.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: a grand cold hall at night; two officials (simple faces, plain dark suits, no insignia) sign a document at a long table; one of them smiles slightly as he caps his pen; tall windows show snow
shots.camera: Slow push-in on the hands and the smile
shots.vo_markup: And far to the north, an empire signed a peace treaty it never meant to *keep.*
shots.vo: And far to the north, an empire signed a peace treaty it never meant to keep.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: TITLE CARD: "THE REFUGE" + "CHAPTER 8 · THE LAST DAYS" over dark drifting sand with a faint white glow
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Deep bass drop on the cut.
